shadow_error_unavailable: Luma couldn’t load the test results. Try again.
shadow_error_dates: Choose valid dates. The end date can’t be before the start date.
shadow_error_session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
shadow_error_role: Your role doesn’t allow testing Workflows. Ask a workspace owner or admin for access.
shadow_error_not_found: This issue or test is no longer available.
shadow_error_unconfirmed: Luma couldn’t confirm the result. Try again to send the same request.
shadow_case_description: See what a Workflow would do with this issue. Preview only. Nothing is changed in your systems.
shadow_case_workflows_empty: Publish a Workflow to test it on this issue.
shadow_case_inputs_hint: Luma uses the current diagnosis and the change the Workflow prepared for this issue. If that change is missing or out of date, the test can’t predict success.
shadow_case_results_empty: This Workflow hasn’t been tested on this issue yet.
shadow_eligibility_stale_evidence: Issue details are out of date
shadow_reason_permission_denied: Your role doesn’t allow this change.
shadow_reason_capability_unavailable: The connection can’t make this change right now.
shadow_reason_stale_intent: The prepared change is out of date.
shadow_reason_approval_required: Your workspace rules require approval for this change.
shadow_predicted_passed: Should succeed if the assumptions hold
shadow_result_no_change: The Workflow didn’t prepare a change for this issue.
shadow_result_checked: {count, plural, one {Checked {time} · {count, number} evidence record} other {Checked {time} · {count, number} evidence records}}
shadow_result_review_evidence: {count, plural, one {{count, number} evidence record · Recorded {time}} other {{count, number} evidence records · Recorded {time}}}
shadow_fields_error_unique: Give each field a unique name.
shadow_review_description: Compare the prediction with what actually happened. You can’t edit a review after you save it.
shadow_review_fits: Should this Workflow handle this issue?
shadow_review_evidence_empty: No evidence is available for this issue yet.
shadow_review_evidence_selected: {count, plural, one {{count, number} evidence record selected} other {{count, number} evidence records selected}}
shadow_review_trust: Would you trust this Workflow to make this change on its own?
shadow_review_error_answers: Answer whether a change was needed and whether this Workflow should handle the issue.
shadow_review_error_time: Choose a time after this test that isn’t in the future.
shadow_review_error_fields: Check the change details, record ID and selected evidence.
shadow_review_uncertain: Luma couldn’t confirm that your review was saved. Retrying sends the same review.
shadow_report_description: Compare the latest test on each issue with what your team did and what Luma confirmed afterward. Estimates show what the Workflow could do. They aren’t completed fixes.
shadow_report_range: Showing {from} through {to} ({timeZone}). Shows up to 500 issues. Choose fewer days to see more.
shadow_report_tested: {count, plural, one {{count, number} issue tested} other {{count, number} issues tested}}
shadow_report_reviewed: {count, plural, one {{count, number} reviewed by your team} other {{count, number} reviewed by your team}}
shadow_metric_agreement_description: Proposed changes that match what your team did.
shadow_metric_unnecessary_description: Reviewed proposals your team marked as not needed.
shadow_metric_missed_description: Issues that needed a change but had no allowed proposal.
shadow_metric_prediction_description: Predictions that match the confirmed outcome.
shadow_metric_autonomous_description: Allowed proposals that are predicted to succeed.
shadow_metric_avoidable_description: Proposals it could make on its own that match changes your team made by hand.
shadow_metric_trust_description: Reviews that would trust the Workflow, out of all yes or no answers.
shadow_report_empty_description: Test this Workflow from an issue, or choose other dates.
